chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him), after one of them stepped forward to speak, he was constrained, while he was [speaking] of the virtue of the Ahl al-Bayt and describing the corruption of the times.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ: Ahl al-Bayt (the Family of the Prophet)

ai.seo_question: What happened when Ja'dah ibn Hubayrah tried to speak about the virtues of the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This incident highlights the profound reverence for the Ahl al-Bayt, where Ja'dah ibn Hubayrah’s inability to fully articulate their virtues underscores their transcendent status beyond ordinary human description. It serves as a poignant commentary on the spiritual and moral decline of the Umayyad era, contrasting the purity of the Prophet's household with the corruption of the ruling class. This moment is often cited by Shia scholars to illustrate the concept of 'Ismah (infallibility) and the unique epistemological authority of the Imams.
